submitted_root_cause: The productcatalogservice deployment attempted a rollout with a non-existent or inaccessible container image (us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/productcatalogservice:agentscope-missing), causing new pods to fail to pull the image and existing pods to report probe failures.
submitted_action: Undo the failed rollout of productcatalogservice to revert to the last known good image version.
